methodology.name: JalDrishti Evidence-Based Multi-Criteria Groundwater Risk Scoring
methodology.sign_convention: positive trend = deepening DTWL (depletion); negative trend = shallowing (recharge)

components.S_LT: Long-term decadal linear trend score (-1 to +4 points, dampened for low-data)
components.S_REC: Recent 4-year trend acceleration score (-1 to +3 points)
components.S_FC: Forecasted 1-year net change & peak seasonal drawdown score (-1 to +3 points)
components.S_depth: Contextual depth pressure vulnerability amplifier (0 to +2 points, active only during active depletion)
components.Guardrails: Recharging Guardrail (no improving block in CRITICAL), Chronic Overdraft Guardrail (no severe depleting block in SAFE), Low-Data Gating, Uncertainty Dominance Dampener

thresholds.critical_threshold: Composite score >= 6 with corroborated positive trend/forecast
thresholds.watch_threshold: Composite score 3 to 5 (moderate/emerging stress) or gated cases
thresholds.safe_threshold: Composite score <= 2 or confirmed negative decadal recharge

known_limitations: Decision-support risk classification based on statistical/ML proxies, not deterministic 3D finite-element physical aquifer flow modeling.
Blocks with history_count < 20 have dampened historical trend weights and rely primarily on regional ML forecast trajectories.
Rainfall data in block_series is currently unpopulated; incorporating local rainfall deficits in future versions will further refine recharge estimation.
